chapter: Chicago, Ohio and Jelly Roll Morton
title: Jelly sends for him in New York: the saxophone section
summary: Called from Indiana to be third alto in Jelly's New York band beside Russell Procope, Joe Garland and Al Sears.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: That's beautiful. [ETC.] Now, how did you meet up with the Missourians, Foots?
See, Jelly Roll sent for me to come to New York. I was...
I think I was in Indiana. And he...for some reason...
What part of Indiana? Indianapolis? Springfield...?
Where Purdue is. Where Purdue is.
No, it ain't Fort Wayne. It's where the university is.

Anyway, he sent for me... But see, I had... Somehow or another I had ended up keeping in touch with Jelly. Evidently, for some reason, he liked me. Now, why I don't know, because I couldn't play no clarinet, but I could play the soprano like a clarinet. And I have to give him credit, because evidently he took a liking to me. Because I kept in touch with him, and he knew where I was when he got this band together in New York. And evidently, he couldn't find no saxophone players. He got ahold of Procope and Garland...
And Joe Garland. And he also had Al Sears in the band. I didn't find this out until later, that Al Sears was in the band. So he needed a third alto player. So he sent for me.
So you three cats played together with Jelly Roll Morton?
...Joe Garland and Al Sears at once? Now, that's four saxophones. Or did you take somebody's place?

No, I didn't take nobody's place. I played third... Sears played baritone, I think. Maybe he played tenor, because I know Procope and I played alto, and Procope played clarinet. And I often wondered what them guys thought. Because see, Jelly sent for me. And I remember wondering what they said: "Who is this little cat they sendin' for?" But one thing -- I could read.
Mmm-hmm. So you were in Indiana, and he sent for you, and... Where did he send for you, to come to New York?
